scientific_integrity: Original proof and executable symbolic/numerical checks of an exact model-specific fold threshold; independent scientific validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two-option deterministic mean-field ODE, balanced positive zealot fractions, q>1; no assertion for unequal zealots or stochastic finite-swarm switching.
All reported equilibrium stability is local; no global attraction or policy optimality is claimed.
Earlier model development, quality-bias bistability, and numerical saddle-node observations are prior art, not new results.
The complete AAMAS 2024 proceedings paper and all associated supplementary material could not be inspected; independent priority audit is not performed.
title: Exact loss of inferior-option coexistence in a quality-biased cross-inhibition model
